metadata.scenario: A patient calls to inquire about the details of their upcoming surgery after receiving the initial consultation results. Category: Follow-up.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Jennifer Taylor. I’m following up about my grandmother’s upcoming surgery. Hi Jennifer! It’s nice to hear from you. How is your grandmother doing? She’s okay, but we’re a bit anxious about the surgery. I wanted to know what kind of support we can get afterward. Of course, that’s completely understandable. We offer Post-Surgery Recovery Care, which includes specialized assistance. Could you tell me more about what that entails? Absolutely! Our Post-Surgery Recovery Care provides 1 to 3 hours of support, generally priced at $85 to $110 per visit. That sounds helpful. What kind of tasks do your caregivers assist with? Our caregivers can help with medication management, personal hygiene, transportation to appointments, and meal preparation. That’s great! My grandmother might need help with daily activities too. We also offer Personal Care Assistance, which is $28 to $35 per hour. This includes help with bathing and grooming. Perfect! I think she would benefit from both services. How do we set that up? I can connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. She can help with the care plan and scheduling. That would be wonderful. Can I have her direct number? Sure! Her number is +13165559203, and she’s available weekdays and Saturdays. Thank you! I’ll reach out to Lisa. Is there anything else I should be aware of? Yes, just a reminder to discuss insurance coverage with her, as we can assist with authorization as well. Oh, right! I’ll make sure to do that. Great! Is there anything else on your mind? No, I think that covers it for now. Thank you so much for your help, Margaret! You’re welcome, Jennifer! We’re here to help, so don’t hesitate to call back if you need anything else. I appreciate it. Have a great day! You too, take care!
